text:
Devin: Heads up — noticed p99 jumps on /v1/generate-route-B right after the routing policy deploy last night. p50/p95 look normal, only p99 is spiking in the route breakdown.
infra-bot: [alert] rollout:v2 applied to 40% traffic -> route-B shard routing change at 2026-03-17T23:12:00Z
Anya: @Devin can you paste the dashboard slice? is it per-region or global?
Devin: here's the link and screenshot (small): https://dash.redwood.internal/r/abcd
Devin: global. p99 from ~120ms -> ~580ms for a ~30min window around the rollout.
Maria: quick thought — we sample requests before routing for aggregation. if sample is per-route and route mix changed, p99 estimator could be biased. :thinking_face:
Ryan: also check KV-prefix cache hits. route-B has a higher cache miss rate after router changed key hashing — that would inflate tail only for that route.
Anya: agreed. two hypotheses: 1) sampling bias in tdigest rollups, 2) backend cache behavior. both could show up as isolated p99 delta.
Selina: can we run a raw histogram query (no rollup) for route-B for that window? less aggregated, exact counts.
Maria: run this query in telemetry: 
```
SELECT latency_ms, count(*) FROM requests
WHERE route = 'route-B' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-17T22:50:00Z' AND '2026-03-17T23:40:00Z'
GROUP BY latency_ms ORDER BY latency_ms DESC LIMIT 1000;
```
Maria: also export sample metadata: which sampling shard the events had.
Devin: I ran a quick raw q and the tail counts are indeed elevated ~600-900ms bucket. sample metadata shows only 12% of route-B events reached the rollup pipeline (we sample at source).
Anya: that sample rate is suspiciously low. if p99 computed from small samples it's noisy. can we bump sampling to 100% for route-B for 1h and recompute rollups? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ryan: +1, but be mindful of ingestion spike. route-B is ~60 req/s, 1h raw should be fine. I'll flip the sampling flag on staging then prod for a short window.
infra-bot: deploy-bot started job: telemetry-sampling-update (target: route-B -> 100%)
Selina: while that's running, check backend logs for cache eviction pattern: 
`grep "route-B" /var/log/service/cache.log | tail -n 200`
Devin: after reenabling full sampling for 45m, recomputed p99 from raw data -> stable around 130ms. so sampling bias looks like the main culprit.
Maria: good catch. follow-up: add a guard in the percentile service to ignore percentiles computed from < 500 samples in a window or surface high-variance flag in the dashboard.
Anya: yes — UX idea: show sample count next to p50/p95/p99 and a small warning if sample_count < threshold. saves noisy alerts.
Ryan: raising PR to add sample_count column to the rollup query and a frontend flag. I'll link shortly.
Devin: thanks all. action items: Ryan -> PR for sample_count + guard, Maria -> plan alert rule to include sample_count, Anya -> quick dashboard flag in next sprint. I'll monitor for 24h.
Selina: :thumbsup:
